title: 第1章 一口断刀
content_zh:
第1章一口断刀
大明404年，乾元七年。
青州，顺德府，黑山城。
夏末近秋，天气虽仍酷热，已有几分秋意。
轰隆隆！
震耳的雷声由远而近，踩踏乌云，自暗沉的天边由远而近。
细密的雨点连成线，自上而下，穿空而落。
自远处的山脉、近处的田地、最后，落尽了灰白城墙圈起来的黑山城之中，遍洒大地。
冰凉的秋雨自屋檐滑落，拍打在街道上为数不多的青石板上，粉身碎骨。
“又下雨了……”
杨狱微微抬头，望着阴沉的天色，心情也不是很好。
他穿着补丁破洞都有的灰色麻布衣衫，踩着一双草鞋，看着这瓢泼大雨，身体就有些发凉。
下雨天，别出门。
这是外城居民间流传的生活常识，他自己也验证过，但……
“唉……婆婆，我上工去了！”
叹了口气，杨狱随手将墙上的斗笠摘下带上，就要出门。
“孩子，慢着点。”
头发花白的老妇人从屋内走出，心疼的握着他的手，将一个鸡蛋塞进他的手里，嘱咐他路上小心。
“婆婆……”
杨狱知道推辞不掉，也只能将鸡蛋带壳塞进了嘴里，含混不清的说了句话，就出了门。

心中也难免有着酸涩，自己前世真算不上富裕家庭，可也从没有因为一个鸡蛋来回推让的。
被收养的这一年里，他也不是没有想过做些什么来改善生活，最后还是放弃了。
这个世道，想要干些什么，太难了。
“呕~”
雨水中，一股恶臭盖住了土腥味，蛮横的钻进了他的鼻子里，让他眼皮狂跳。
自来到这个世界的半年里，最让杨狱不能忍受的，并不是没有电、网、手机，
而是这里的人，不讲卫生。
随地大小便的，简直比比皆是，正常的时候还好，一下雨，那简直就是灾难。
大雨清洗一切，能够轻易的将阴暗角落里，一些人畜的排泄物冲涮出来。
那场景，简直是恐怖！
他当然没有洁癖，可这谁顶得住？
“一定要搬家，搬家！”
杨狱咬牙，小心的抬脚，尽量走高处。
雨中的黑山城人也不是很少，有人在雨中擦拭身子，有人在冲洗农具，当然，也有洗涮粪桶的。
杨狱目不斜视，缩手缩脚的走过小巷，街道，穿过广场，才停下脚步。
内城到了。
低矮却修葺一新的城墙，隔开了内外两城。
相比外城，内城稍微整洁一些，排水之类的设施也好上不少，到了这里，他的速度快了不少。
没一会，就能远远的看到衙门的石狮子。
衙门，很老旧，不少地方更是年久失修摇摇欲坠，不少地方甚至有着杂草。

若不是那对石狮子，杨狱第一次来的时候几乎没认出这是衙门。
衙门当然有钱，更不缺维护的钱，可明明能撞进自己的腰包里的钱，谁会拿出来修衙门？
官不修衙，可不止是黑山城这么干。
“小狱来的挺早。”
身后有人打了个招呼。
杨狱回头，同样的蓑衣斗笠下，是一张同样稚嫩的脸。
他叫朱十三，和杨狱一样，是个衙役。
“嗯，怕雨越下越大。”
杨狱随口搭了一句话。
“唉，真羡慕你。只需要守着库房就行，我们，怕是还要巡街……”
朱十三脸色愁苦，有着羡慕。
“呵呵。”
杨狱勉强一笑。
他们是衙役，不是吏，可以说算是徭役的一种，与劳役、兵役并无区别，实实在在的苦差事。
前数一百年，他们这样的不但没有工钱，还要自备干粮。
可就这样的活计，要不是收养他的老爷子是个狱卒，也根本轮不到他。
无他，衙役虽然是苦差，但却是有着转正的可能的。
“算算日子，新一批犯人也快送到了，希望不会有什么凶人……”
朱十三有些兴奋，又有些担忧。
黑山城，是座狱城。

顺德府之内的犯人，多半都会送到这里来，待到秋后，或是就地处斩，或是与其他府的犯人一并押往青州州府。
往年，可有不少劫狱的凶人的。
伴随着凶险，却也是他们转正的希望……
“希望吧。”
杨狱一脸木然的叹了口气。
从一个即将踏入大学校园的法学生，变成一个流民，现在的衙门临时工，他是崩溃的。
但他也不是什么依仗都没有。
那口疑似将自己带到此界的‘鼎’此时还如胎记一般贴在自己肚子上。
可惜，暂时用不了。
两人有一搭没一搭的聊了几句，哪里又有案子，谁谁家又有人死了，最近染病的人多了起来，怜生教生意好的不行等等。
多是朱十三再说，杨狱静静听着。
没多久点卯的官吏到了，打了个照面，就自顾自做事去了。
衙门的库房很清闲，交接了班，杨狱只一个时辰就干完了一天的活。
前世今生的文字语言自然不同，但数学却是通用的，这衙门库房的伙计对刚备战过高考的他来说，当然不是问题。
做完了活计，他才从角落拿出一个包裹着严实的小布袋。
摊开，里面是一本书以及一些细小的石子。
‘希望对得起我吃的这些石头……’
拈起一枚石子，杨狱心中叹气，木着脸飞快吞了下去。
直到感受到身体内一闪而过几乎不可察觉的热流，才精神微震。
穷文富武，人穷又想练武，怎么办？

啃石头！
众所周知，一块小小的石头，包含了大量的无机盐成分，于他这个穷人而言，是上佳的补品。
只要石头吃得好，吃得快，就能成为人生赢家，武林高手不是梦……
这当然是不可能的，石头吃多了只会胃下垂。
杨狱没有自虐的癖好，之所以把石子当零食吃，全是因为那口鼎。
这口鼎的开启需要能量，而这能量的来源，居然只局限于‘泥土’‘石头’……
为了开启这口鼎，他已经吃了一年的石头了……
就着石头，他翻开了案上的书，
在这个大部分人都没有走出过百里地界的年代，读书是他除了酒馆说书人之外唯一能够了解这个世界的渠道。
一年里，他也借来了几本书，对于这个时代有了个初步的了解。
可惜，却不是他熟知的任何朝代。
“大明404年，乾元七年，青州，顺德府……真的是完全陌生的世界啊！”
长长叹了口气，杨狱收起书，准备结束早上的工作。
这时，突然听到库房外传来一阵嘈杂声，伴随着一声声吸气，惊呼。
“又死人了？”
杨狱刚把书合上，也没在意。
“唉……”
披着蓑衣，浑身湿漉漉的朱十三已经窜进了库房，埋怨着衙门里到处坑水，神色却有些闪躲。
“谁死了？”
杨狱将书收好，站起身。

“小狱，你…你要节哀啊。你家老爷子他……”
朱十三压低声音，面露不忍。
“什么节哀？你胡说什么？”
杨狱心中‘咯噔’一下，站起，没来由的有些慌乱。
想起了那位只见过几面，就押送犯人去青州的狱卒老爷子。
他这一世无父无母，流民出身，若非遇到老爷子，只怕早已死在外面了。
“你家老爷子他出事了，之前我看到你们族里有人来了衙门，怕也是得了老爷子的死讯……
不，不对。应该，应该是失踪的消息……”
朱十三低声说着，有些不敢看杨狱的眼睛。
失踪等于死，衙门里的人都知道。
之所以报成失踪，是因为死了要抚恤。
不需要……
“怎么会……”
杨狱喉头涌动，心中有些发堵。
初来此界的自己浑浑噩噩，若不是这位老人收留自己，只怕沦落为乞儿的自己早已死了吧？
“哼！”
库房外，却传来一声冷喝，一个铁塔也似的中年人跨入库房，冷冷的扫了一眼朱十三：
“再敢乱说话，老子拔了你的舌头！”
“王捕头！”
朱十三噤若寒蝉，吓得腿都软了几分。

“拿住，这是老杨的刀！”
铁塔也似的中年人一抬手，一把带着铁锈味的断刀已经到了杨狱的手里。
“这刀……”
接过刀，杨狱身子一颤。
“老杨他，是真的失踪。”
冷硬的说了一句，见这少年拿着刀身子颤抖的样子，也不由心中叹息。
失去了顶梁柱，对于这样一个家庭来说，可说是灭顶之灾了。
一时，他有话也说不出口了，只能说了句“抚恤的事，有我！”，转身就走了。
“王捕头慢走。”
朱十三松了口气，又担忧的看了一眼杨狱，扭头也走了。
“这口刀……”
杨狱却好似没有在意两人的态度与离去，神色恍惚的喃喃自语着。
他一只手握着断刀，一只手却捂住了胸口。
content_en:
Chapter 1 A broken knife
Ming Dynasty 404, Qianyuan seventh year.
Qingzhou, Shunde Prefecture, Heishan City.
It's late summer and almost autumn, and although the weather is still very hot, it already feels like autumn.
Boom!
The ear-splitting thunder comes from far and near, stepping on the dark clouds, from far and near from the dark horizon.
Fine raindrops formed a line, falling from top to bottom through the sky.
From the mountains in the distance, to the fields nearby, and finally, to the Black Mountain City surrounded by gray-white walls, it spread all over the land.
The cold autumn rain fell from the eaves, hitting the few bluestones on the street, shattering the bones.
"It's raining again..."
Yang Yu raised his head slightly and looked at the gloomy sky, feeling not in a good mood.
He was wearing a gray linen shirt with patches and holes and a pair of straw sandals. Looking at the pouring rain, his body felt a little chilly.
Don't go out on rainy days.
This is common sense among residents in the outer city, and he has verified it himself, but...
"Oh...mother-in-law, I'm going to work!"
Sighing, Yang Yu took off the bamboo hat on the wall and put it on before going out.
"Kid, slow down."
The gray-haired old woman walked out of the house, held his hand distressedly, put an egg into his hand, and told him to be careful on the road.
"Mother-in-law..."
Yang Yu knew he couldn't refuse, so he could only stuff the egg in its shell into his mouth, said something vaguely, and went out.
It was inevitable that I would feel sour in my heart. I was not from a wealthy family in my previous life, but I had never been pushed back and forth over an egg.
During the year he was adopted, it was not like he never thought about doing something to improve his life, but finally gave up.
It’s so difficult to do anything in this world.
"Ugh~"
In the rain, a stench covered up the earthy smell and penetrated his nose arrogantly, making his eyelids twitch wildly.
In the six months since he came to this world, the most unbearable thing for Yang Yu is not the lack of electricity, Internet, and mobile phones.
But the people here don't care about hygiene.
People urinating and urinating everywhere are everywhere. It's fine when it's normal, but when it rains, it's a disaster.
The heavy rain cleans everything and can easily flush out some human and animal excrement from dark corners.
That scene was simply terrifying!
Of course he has no mysophobia, but who can resist this?
"We must move, move!"
Yang Yu gritted his teeth, carefully raised his feet, and tried to walk as high as possible.
There are not many people in Heishan City in the rain. Some people are wiping themselves in the rain, some are washing farm tools, and of course, there are also people washing dung buckets.
Without squinting, Yang Yu walked through the alleys, streets, and squares timidly, and then stopped.
The inner city has arrived.
The low but newly renovated city wall separates the inner and outer cities.
Compared with the outer city, the inner city is a little tidier and has much better facilities such as drainage. When he got here, he was much faster.
After a while, you can see the stone lion of the Yamen from a distance.
The Yamen is very old, and many places are in disrepair and are crumbling, and there are even weeds in many places.
If it weren't for the pair of stone lions, Yang Yu would have hardly recognized it as a yamen when he first arrived.
Of course the yamen has money, and there is no shortage of money for maintenance, but who will use the money to repair the yamen when it can be put into their own pockets?
Officials do not build yamen, but Heishan City is not the only one doing this.
"Xiao Jing came quite early."
Someone behind me said hello.
Yang Yu turned around and saw the same childish face under the same coir raincoat and bamboo hat.
His name is Zhu Shisan, and like Yang Yu, he is a government servant.
"Well, I'm afraid the rain will get heavier."
Yang Yu made a casual remark.
"Oh, I really envy you. You only need to guard the warehouse, and we, I'm afraid, have to patrol the streets..."
Zhu Shisan looked sad and envious.
"Haha."
Yang Yu forced a smile.
They are government servants, not officials. They can be said to be a type of corvee service, which is no different from labor service or military service.Drudgery.
A hundred years ago, they not only had no wages, but also had to provide their own dry food.
But for such a job, if the old man who adopted him hadn't been a jailer, he wouldn't have had his turn at all.
Without him, although the yamen service is a hard job, it is possible to become a regular employee.
"Counting the days, a new batch of prisoners will be arriving soon. I hope there won't be any murderers..."
Zhu Shisan was a little excited and a little worried.
Black Mountain City is a prison city.
Most of the prisoners in Shunde Prefecture will be sent here. After autumn, they will either be executed on the spot or taken to Qingzhou Prefecture together with prisoners from other prefectures.
In previous years, there were many murderers who robbed prisons.
Along with danger, there is also hope for them to become normal...
"I hope so."
Yang Prison sighed with a dull look on his face.
From a law student who was about to enter college, to a refugee, and now a temporary worker in a government office, he was completely devastated.
But he didn't have anything to rely on.
The 'cauldron' that seemed to have brought him to this world was still attached to his stomach like a birthmark.
Unfortunately, it is not available for the time being.
The two chatted for a while, whether there was a case somewhere, someone died in so-and-so's family, more people were sick recently, whether Liansheng's teaching business was doing well, etc.
Most likely it was Zhu Shisan who spoke, while Yang Yu listened quietly.
Not long after, the official from Dianmao arrived, had a face-to-face meeting, and then went to do his own thing.
The warehouse of the Yamen was very busy. After the shift was handed over, Yang Yu finished the day's work in just one hour.
The writing and language of past and present lives are naturally different, but mathematics is universal. The clerk in the yamen warehouse is certainly not a problem for him who has just prepared for the college entrance examination.
After finishing his work, he took out a tightly wrapped small cloth bag from the corner.
Spread out, there is a book and some small pebbles inside.
'I hope I am worthy of the stones I have eaten...'
Picking up a stone, Yang Yu sighed in his heart and swallowed it quickly with a wooden face.
It wasn't until he felt the almost imperceptible heat passing through his body that he felt slightly shaken.
What should we do if we are poor in literature and rich in martial arts, but we are poor and want to practice martial arts?
Chew on rocks!
As we all know, a small stone contains a large amount of inorganic salts, which is an excellent tonic for a poor man like him.
As long as you eat stones well and quickly, you can become a winner in life. Being a martial arts master is not a dream...
This is of course impossible. Eating too many stones will only cause gastroptosis.
Yang Prison has no habit of self-abuse. The reason why he eats stones as snacks is all because of the cauldron.
The opening of this cauldron requires energy, and the source of this energy is actually limited to 'soil' and 'stone'...
In order to open this cauldron, he has been eating stones for a year...
He turned to the stone and opened the book on the case.
In this era when most people have never traveled beyond the border of hundreds of miles, reading is the only way for him to understand the world besides being a storyteller in the tavern.
During the year, he also borrowed several books and gained a preliminary understanding of this era.
Unfortunately, it was not any dynasty he was familiar with.
"In the 404th year of the Ming Dynasty, the seventh year of the Qianyuan Dynasty, Qingzhou and Shunde Prefecture... it was really a completely strange world!"
With a long sigh, Yang Prison put away his books and prepared to finish his morning work.
At this time, I suddenly heard a burst of noise coming from outside the warehouse, accompanied by gasps and exclamations.
"Another death?"
Yang Yu just closed the book and didn't care.
"Alas..."
Zhu Shisan, who was wearing a raincoat and soaked all over, had already rushed into the warehouse, complaining about the puddles everywhere in the yamen, but his expression was a little evasive.
"Who died?"
Yang Yu put the book away and stood up.
"Xiaojiu, you...you have to express your condolences. Your old man..."
Zhu Shisan lowered his voice and showed unbearable expression.
"What condolences? What nonsense are you talking about?"
Yang Yu's heart thumped and he stood up, a little panicked for no reason.chaos.
I thought of the old jailer who I met only a few times before escorting the prisoners to Qingzhou.
He had neither father nor mother in his life and was born as a refugee. If he had not met the old man, he would have died outside long ago.
"Something happened to your old man. I saw someone from your clan come to the Yamen before. I'm afraid they also got the news of the old man's death...
No, that's not right. It should, it should be news of the disappearance..."
Zhu Shisan whispered, not daring to look into Yang Yu's eyes.
Missing is equal to death, everyone in the yamen knows this.
The reason why he was reported missing was because he needed compensation if he died.
No need...
"How could..."
Yang Yu's throat surged and he felt a little clogged in his heart.
When I first came to this world, I was confused. If this old man hadn't taken me in, I would have been reduced to a beggar and would have died long ago, right?
"Hmph!"
Outside the warehouse, a cold shout came. A middle-aged man who looked like an iron tower stepped into the warehouse and glanced at Zhu Shisan coldly:
"If you dare to talk nonsense again, I will pull out your tongue!"
"The king catches the head!"
Zhu Shisan was as silent as a cicada, and his legs were so frightened that they became weak.
"Hold it, this is Lao Yang's knife!"
The middle-aged man who looked like an iron tower raised his hand, and a broken knife smelling of rust was already in Yang Yu's hand.
"This knife..."
After taking the knife, Yang Yu's body trembled.
"Lao Yang is really missing."
He said something coldly, and when he saw the young man trembling while holding the sword, he couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
Losing the backbone of the family can be said to be a disaster for such a family.
For a moment, he couldn't say anything. He could only say, "I'm responsible for the pension!", turned around and left.
"Wang Captou, walk slowly."
Zhu Shisan breathed a sigh of relief, glanced at Yang Yu worriedly, turned around and left.
"This knife..."
However, Yang Yu didn't seem to care about the two people's attitudes and departure, and murmured to himself in a daze.
He held the broken knife in one hand, and covered his chest with the other.
